# DCA Tracker

> DCA Tracker is a free browser-based DCA and VA investment planning tool. It includes a VA定投计算器 for calculating value-averaging contribution targets, records portfolio execution history, and stores user data locally without requiring an account.

## Core pages

- Home and calculator: https://dca.020023.xyz/
- VA and DCA FAQ: https://dca.020023.xyz/faq
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/Fe1ix-deng/dca-tracker
- Chinese project documentation: https://github.com/Fe1ix-deng/dca-tracker/blob/main/README.md
- English project documentation: https://github.com/Fe1ix-deng/dca-tracker/blob/main/README.en.md

## Key capabilities

- DCA fixed-amount and VA value-averaging strategies
- Suggested contribution and share calculations
- Multiple investment plans and multi-asset portfolios
- Local browser storage with JSON and CSV export
- Chinese and English interfaces
